summary: Research candidate RC-19, a rail finding. Tests load the real .env (vitest.config.ts:2-4). They then open and migrate the live DB at import: src/utils/db.ts:9 falls back to cwd/data/bot.db, :17 opens it, :232 writes user_version 7 unconditionally, :235 runs migrateSchema(). Any test file that imports src/utils/db unmocked can write kill-switch, dedup and resume state in data/bot.db. The planned SAFE-02 rails (22-05, 22-07..22-10) mitigate it. Nothing else is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
